subject.title: feat(ui): editable file panel with CodeMirror and sessions.files.set hash-CAS writes

question: Should OpenClaw standardize this focused CodeMirror plus `sessions.files.set` design as the canonical core editing path instead of the broader approach in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95956?
rationale: The linked issue has explicit maintainer product and security signals, and two overlapping implementations differ materially in API and feature scope; code review cannot choose the permanent core contract.

options.title: Sponsor this focused contract
options.body: Repair the Markdown and conflict-safety defects, add real-gateway proof, and use this PR as the canonical implementation.

options.title: Prefer the broader alternative
options.body: Adopt https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95956 only after confirming its image, metadata, and mutation scope is the desired permanent contract.

options.title: Defer core editing
options.body: Keep the existing read-only viewer and decline both remote workspace mutation proposals for now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor this focused contract
recommendation.body: Repair the Markdown and conflict-safety defects, add real-gateway proof, and use this PR as the canonical implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current viewer and have the strongest merged history on the exact gateway and Control UI surface.
